method: difflib.SequenceMatcher combined score = 0.25*ratio(email localpart) + 0.75*ratio(firstname+lastname+company); matched at combined >= 0.8

decisions.rationale: Same first and last name, but email localparts differ (ahmad.hassan98 vs ahassan) with no clear pattern indicating they belong to the same person, and companies differ (Self-employed vs Maybank) with no overlapping detail to suggest a single individual; insufficient evidence to merge.
